user.title: Whereabouts
user.description: Live map and location history for your persons. Everything can be changed later under Configure.

data.record_persons: Record the history of these persons
data.address_source: Addresses for places on the way

data_description.live_card: Shows the persons live on a map. Uses only what Home Assistant already knows, nothing is stored.
data_description.history_card: Shows where the recorded persons were on a chosen day, as a route or table.
data_description.record_persons: Nothing is recorded until you choose persons here. The history is stored only on this Home Assistant (folder whereabouts in the configuration directory) and is kept until you delete it.
data_description.address_source: Companion app (geocoded location): the address the Home Assistant Companion app on the phone already determined – stays local. The sensor "Geocoded location" must be switched on in the app on the phone (Companion app settings → Sensors / Manage sensors → Geocoded location). If it has no fitting address, OpenStreetMap is asked instead (default): the coordinates of that place are sent to nominatim.openstreetmap.org. You can also use only the Companion app, only OpenStreetMap or no addresses.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: For places on the way, an address is stored with the stay. Below, per recorded person ({persons}), the sensor "Geocoded location" of the person's Companion app; it is found automatically. If it is missing: switch it on in the Companion app on the phone.

data_description.address_max_distance: The geocoding of the Companion app often lags behind. If its position is further away from the stored point, no (wrong) address is used.

access.title: Who may see and delete the history
access.description: Applies to the history only. The live map shows what every Home Assistant user can see anyway.

data_description.history_access: "Own person" means the person linked to the user account (Settings → People).

import_file.title: Import history
import_file.description: Supported: Whereabouts CSV (also what the export writes), the daily files of the original script version (one file or a ZIP of many) and GPX. The format is described in the documentation (FORMAT.md). {detail}

data_description.target_person: Required for GPX. For CSV files, leave empty to use the person named in the file.
data_description.replace: Off: entries that already exist (same start time) are skipped. On: every day in the file replaces the stored day completely.

error.unknown_format: The file format was not recognized.
error.unreadable: The file could not be read.
error.too_large: The file is too large (max. 50 MB, ZIP content max. 200 MB).
error.no_points: The file contains no usable entries.
error.person_required: Please choose the person this file belongs to.
error.unknown_person: The file names a person that does not exist in Home Assistant. Choose the person to import into.

abort.import_done: Imported for {persons}: {added} entries on {days} days ({skipped} already existed).
